title: Host-native operator questions
summary: Agents MUST use the host question tool for operator input, and MUST ask in chat with the gap flagged when it is unavailable.
instructions: Before an agent reports a needed secret as missing, it MUST check the repository-local `.env` file when that file exists.
An agent MUST use a secret only for its authorized operation.
An agent MUST NOT print, quote, persist, or expose a secret value.

instructions.text: When `config.json` names an unavailable Cursor model, an agent MUST check `.env` for `CURSOR_API_KEY` before operator escalation.
When `CURSOR_API_KEY` exists, the agent MUST use `Cursor.models.list()` to refresh `governance/registries/cursor_model_catalog.json`.
After the catalog refresh, the agent MUST rerun model validation.
The agent MUST ask the operator only when the recovery flow remains blocked.

instructions: An agent MUST treat `cursor/ask_question` in Cursor, `vscode/askQuestions` in VS Code, and `ask_user` in Copilot CLI as the host question tool. `governance/registries/host_tools.json` maps each host.

An agent that a host client runs MUST use the host question tool when it needs operator clarification or an operator decision. It needs one only under the escalation conditions `PRINCIPLES-001` states. An ordinary judgment call is made and reported, not asked.

Under a long-horizon contract the operator is absent by design, and a waiting question is a stopped run. An agent MUST raise a question there only for a hard block the long-horizon policy enumerates. Every other matter is decided, recorded in the stage output, and carried forward.
When the host question tool is unavailable, the agent MUST ask the question in its normal response channel.
The agent MUST state in that message that the host question tool was unavailable.
A worker inside a run MUST write the question and the unavailability into its stage output. It MUST use the structured `operator_question` field, with a non-empty question, reason, and evidence.

instructions.text: The supervisor MUST surface that question to the operator.

instructions: An agent that asked a question MUST NOT proceed on an assumed answer to it, and MUST NOT fail silently.
An agent MUST NOT report `blocked` only because it could not use the host question tool.
An agent MUST report `blocked` only when its contract requires that result for work that cannot continue.
A question through the host question tool MUST add to the `blocked` route and MUST NOT replace it.
A question through the host question tool MUST NOT replace a workflow gate or an operator approval.
A headless or external-executor persona MUST NOT call a host question tool, because no operator client hosts its session.
A headless or external-executor persona MUST ask in its normal response channel instead.
Canonical agent frontmatter MUST NOT name or block a question-method identifier.
